add_clip.description: Add a clip of an asset to a track (`timeline_service.add_clip`).

id.description: Id for the new clip, so later ops in this batch can name it (letters, digits, `_`, `-`, `.`). Generated deterministically from the batch and this op's position when absent; the result reports it.

in.description: Seconds into the source where the clip starts.

index.description: Magnetic track: zero-based position to insert at (default: the end). Not allowed on other tracks.

start.description: Other tracks: where the clip begins (default: after the last clip).

font_size.description: Text height as a fraction of the frame height (text clips only).

id.description: Id for the new clip, so later ops in this batch can name it (letters, digits, `_`, `-`, `.`). Generated deterministically from the batch and this op's position when absent; the result reports it.

x.description: Overlay centre, as a fraction of the frame width.

y.description: Overlay centre, as a fraction of the frame height (text: 0.85).

add_track.description: Append an empty track on top of the stack (`timeline_service.add_track`).

id.description: Id for the new track, so later ops in this batch can name it (letters, digits, `_`, `-`, `.`). Generated deterministically from the batch and this op's position when absent; the result reports it.

clip.description: Id of the clip (from show_timeline, or the `id` of an earlier op in this batch).

set_clip_properties.description: Change gain, mute, overlay placement, colour or crop of a clip (`timeline_service.set_clip_properties`).

clip.description: Id of the clip (from show_timeline, or the `id` of an earlier op in this batch).

crop.description: Media clips on video tracks: the part of the source frame to show, as fractions of the frame with the origin at its top-left. Absent = the whole frame. x, y in 0..1; w, h from 0.02 to 1; x+w and y+h at most 1. Applied before the clip is scaled to fit the output frame, so for a vertical short compute it with the `crop_for_aspect` helper (CLI `compose crop --aspect 9:16`, MCP `set_clip_crop`, GET /api/v1/assets/{id}/reframe) rather than by hand. `null` removes the crop.

y.description: Top edge (fraction of the source height).

locked.description: A locked track refuses every edit of its clips until it is unlocked.

description: A batch of timeline edits applied in order and atomically to an existing project: all of them or none. Strict: unknown ops and fields are rejected. Constraints this schema cannot express (clip and track ids exist, assets exist, in/out within the asset, no overlaps, crossfade room) are checked by the server and reported with stable codes; see docs/edit-ops.md. At most 1000 ops.

base_revision.description: The revision of the project these ops were written against; the batch fails with a 409 / revision conflict, writing nothing, if it has moved on. null or absent: apply to the latest version.

continue_on_error.description: Dry run only: keep going after a failing op and report every independent problem (ops that use an id from a failed op are `ops.skipped_dependency`). By default the first failing op stops the batch.

meta.description: Free-form notes for the caller; echoed in the response, never stored or validated.

project.description: Name of the existing timeline project to edit.

schema_version.description: Version of this ops format. Additive optional fields keep the version; a breaking change bumps it.
